distribution_definition: Hungarian squared-distance assignment of centered coordinates; no rotation; RMS/R; all common saved times
stop: A failures do not prevent B. Local+true geometry+true normal force balance required. First 3 QPs; <=5 only documented evidence. Fresh initial state for every trajectory.
group_scope: COM .02um is 26.7% of .075um target tolerance. Signal must exceed measured dt/cache differences; stationary OFF is a validated null, not control.
shape_control_cost: Navigation candidate endpoint Rg change <=5% and one connected component; otherwise explicitly report shape cost.
topology_scope: Full initial-network survival over 2ms and matched persistent events; instantaneous edge timing independently reported. Later events right-censored, not disproved.
initial: Unchanged manual near-contact 32-ID demo, not acoustic formation

candidate_design.method: bounded deterministic pressure-constrained primary COM proposal optimization, not surrogate evidence of navigation

numerical_scope: A/F frozen at x_n through each physical step; constraints/reactions updated at candidate x_{n+1}; no PBD, no spring, no repeated physical time.
